latest.notes:
Generating a log now shows what it is actually doing.

Instead of a single 'Hour N of 24' covering three different passes, you get the passes themselves — Laying the breaks, Scheduling commercials, Scheduling music — each filling as it runs and ticking green when it finishes, with the hour it is working on.

The list matches the run: a music-only regenerate shows one step, a full regenerate shows three. A step that run doesn't perform is never ticked.

This is why a full regenerate looked like it scheduled music before the commercials. It doesn't, and never did — the progress just couldn't tell you which pass you were watching.
